description: Electrical apparatus; photosensitive semiconductor devices, photovoltaic cells assembled in modules or made up into panels

predecessors.note: Before 2022 solar modules were reported inside HS 854140 with all other photosensitive devices. The continuous long series is at HS-4 8541.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.
